definitions.gloss: semi-finished product; work in progress; intermediate product
definitions.explanation: A product that has gone through some stages of manufacturing but is not yet a finished good ready for sale. It may be sold to another manufacturer for further processing or stored as inventory.

examples.japanese: {半製品|はんせいひん}を{別|べつ}の{工場|こうじょう}に{送|おく}る。
examples.english: Send the semi-finished products to another factory.

examples.japanese: {半製品|はんせいひん}の{在庫|ざいこ}{管理|かんり}が{課題|かだい}になっている。
examples.english: Inventory management of semi-finished products has become an issue.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{半製品|はんせいひん}を{輸入|ゆにゅう}し、{国内|こくない}で{最終|さいしゅう}{加工|かこう}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: This company imports semi-finished products and does the final processing domestically.

notes:
A compound of {半|はん} (half, semi-) and {製品|せいひん} (manufactured product). Used in manufacturing, accounting, and supply chain contexts. In accounting, semi-finished goods are classified as inventory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半製品|はんせいひん}の{在庫|ざいこ}: semi-finished product inventory
- {半製品|はんせいひん}を{加工|かこう}する: to process semi-finished products
- {半製品|はんせいひん}{倉庫|そうこ}: semi-finished product warehouse
- {半製品|はんせいひん}の{段階|だんかい}: semi-finished stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完成品|かんせいひん}: finished product — a product ready for sale or use
- {仕掛品|しかかりひん}: work in process — an accounting term for products still on the production line
- {原材料|げんざいりょう}: raw materials — materials that have not yet undergone any manufacturing
